01

“Whoever desires honor”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 35:10).

01
Explanation from Mujāhid 01

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
Whoever desires honor [Fatir 10] meaning: "through the worship of idols."
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيدُ الْعِزَّةَ [فاطر: 10] ، يَعْنِي: «بِعِبَادَةِ الْأَوْثَانِ»
Edition record 373142 · p. 557Link to report ↗
02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
To Him ascends good speech, and righteous deeds raise it [Fatir 10] He says: "the righteous deed is what raises the good speech."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
إِلَيْهِ يَصْعَدُ الْكَلِمُ الطِّيبُ وَالْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ يَرْفَعُهُ [فاطر: 10] يَقُولُ: «الْعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ هُوَ الَّذِي يَرْفَعُ الْكَلِمَ الطِّيبَ»

02

“they do not possess [even] the membrane of a date seed [qitmir]”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 35:13).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
they do not possess [even] the membrane of a date seed [qitmir] [Fatir 13] he said: "The qitmir is the wrapping of the date stone."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْ قِطْمِيرٍ [فاطر: 13] قَالَ: " الْقِطْمِيرُ: لِفَافَةُ النَّوَاةِ "
Edition record 373144 · p. 557Link to report ↗
03

“And if one heavily laden should call”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 35:18).

04
Explanation from Mujāhid 04

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words:
And if one heavily laden should call [Fatir 18] meaning: "laden with sins," for [another to carry] its load, nothing of it will be carried [Fatir 18] he said: It is like His words no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another [al-Anam 164].
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
وَإِنْ تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ [فاطر: 18] يَعْنِي: «مُثْقَلَةً ذَنُوبًا» إِلَى حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلُ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ [فاطر: 18] قَالَ: هُوَ كَقَوْلِهِ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَى [الأنعام: 164]
Edition record 373145 · p. 557Link to report ↗
05
Report from Mujāhid 05

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Warqa related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said:
"The one who wrongs himself: the companions of the left; the moderate: the companions of the right; and the one who is foremost in good deeds: those who preceded among all the nations."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
" الظَّالِمُ لِنَفْسِهِ: أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ، وَالْمُقْتَصِدُ: أَصْحَابُ الْمَيْمَنَةِ، وَالسَّابِقُ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ: السَّابِقُونَ مِنَ الْأُمَمِ كُلِّهَا "
Edition record 373146 · p. 557Link to report ↗
04

“Did We not grant you a life long enough for whoever would remember…”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 35:37).

06
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 06

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, saying: Ibrahim related to us, saying: Adam related to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Ismail ibn Abi Fudayk related to us, from Ibrahim ibn al-Fadl, from Ibn Abi Husayn al-Makki, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
⦗p. 558⦘ The Messenger of God ﷺ said: "When the Day of Resurrection comes, it will be said: 'Where are the sixty-year-olds?' That is the lifespan of which God, Mighty and Majestic, said: Did We not grant you a life long enough for whoever would remember to remember in it? [Fatir 37]." Ibn Abi Fudayk said: and al-Hasan ibn Abd God ibn Atiyya related to us, from someone who related it to him, from Ibn Abbas, who said: "meaning by it gray hair."
العربية
الإسناد
أنا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، نا آدَمُ، نا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي حُسَيْنٍ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 558⦘ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:
" إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ قِيلَ: أَيْنَ أَبْنَاءُ السِّتِّينَ وَهُوَ الْعُمُرُ الَّذِي قَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: أَوَلَمْ نُعَمِّرْكُمْ مَا يَتَذَكَّرُ فِيهِ مَنْ تَذَكَّرَ [فاطر: 37] ". قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ: «يَعْنِي بِهِ الشَّيْبَ»
